blocks.text: I can assist someone in remaining abstinent and advancing in their recovery once they have decided to make a change in their use of substances. centre.name: Evolution Addiction Counselling
centre.about_html:
Evolution Addiction Counselling is a virtual and in-person addiction treatment practice that serves individuals throughout Nova Scotia and the rest of Canada. They are situated in Bedford, Nova Scotia.

I’ve had the chance to work with a number of individuals who are addicted over the last twenty years. The particular characteristics and circumstances of each individual are taken into account in the most successful addiction treatment programs. In order to address an individual’s unique needs, I utilize my expertise with a variety of treatment models and theoretical viewpoints in clinical practice.

I can assist someone in remaining abstinent and advancing in their recovery once they have decided to make a change in their use of substances. Addiction treatment is about improving one’s overall quality of life and learning how to engage with their past, present, and future in a healthy way. Addiction treatment additionally helps people avoid a return to substance use, which I assist individuals with through relapse prevention techniques.

Specialties of Evolution Addiction Counselling

Addiction

Substance Use

Alcohol Use

Drug Abuse

 

Types of Therapy

Attachment-based

Cognitive Behavioural (CBT)

Eclectic

Expressive Arts

Family Systems

Humanistic

Intervention

Mindfulness-Based (MBCT)

Motivational Interviewing

Person-Centered

Positive Psychology

Psychodynamic

Strength-Based

Counselling services

Rates

Counselling services – $120 hourly

 

Peter B. Snelgrove MA CCAC

 

Certified member of the Canadian Addiction Counsellors Certification Federation

Canadian Certified Addiction Counsellor

Canadian Certified Telemedicine Addiction Counselling Professional
